auth.token_lifetime: short-lived; exact seconds returned at issue (docs: 'Dropbox access tokens are short lived')
auth.refresh: Include token_access_type=offline in authorization URL to receive a refresh token; exchange at /oauth2/token

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: App starts in Development status limited to 50 users (UNVERIFIED); production approval via Dropbox review (UNVERIFIED not fetched)
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Team admin authorizes the app; per Dropbox, scopes requested via the Business API yield a token 'associated with the team (rather than the administrator who authorized it)'. Use Dropbox-API-Select-User header to act as members.

sandbox.how_to_get: Free Dropbox account (Business-API needs a team; Dropbox Business trial UNVERIFIED)

events: file change notification (webhook with cursor poll)

incremental_sync: files/list_folder returns a cursor; files/list_folder/continue and longpoll for changes (UNVERIFIED not fetched)
sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/docs/oauth — 'Dropbox access tokens are short lived'; token_access_type=offline; team-scoped token association
